title: Microsoft 365 Native vs Third-Party Security: When Defender Is Enough and When It Is Not
content_md: Microsoft 365 native vs third-party security is not a winner-takes-all debate; it is a fit-for-purpose decision. Most Microsoft 365 organizations already have native protection, so the real buying question is whether those controls match the company’s risk profile, compliance burden, staffing level, and recovery expectations.
